status: Prespecified source-only confirmation; no compile or performance execution authorized
population_contract: insert only; allocate_insert is unavailable and has no trial vector
serial_schedule_limitation: Serial occupies first/last only; control/candidate have identical positions and ABBA pair order
case_order: Seed1 forward finite geometry/T/language order; seed2 exact reverse; no post-data reordering

input.generator: SplitMix64(index): z=0x243f6a8885a308d3+(index+1)*0x9e3779b97f4a7c15; standard two wrapping mixers; prehashed before clocks
input.hotspot: Only new hashes have high32 cleared; history remains uniform
input.query_mapping: i%3==0 new[i%n], i%3==1 history[i%history_n] else new[(i*17)%n] if no history, remaining generated negatives

clock_contract.insert: Fresh filter allocation/prefill outside clock; original-T public wrapper insertion inside clock
clock_contract.allocate_insert: Empty cases only; affinity expansion before clock; constructor plus original-T public wrapper insertion inside clock
clock_contract.included: policy selection, all native partition/scratch allocation, count/scatter/insert passes, thread creation and joins
clock_contract.excluded: input generation, CPU-affinity changes, validation, prepopulation, destruction
clock_contract.prefill: Separate diagnostic setup duration; never subtracted from a primary timer
clock_contract.unit: nanoseconds per newly inserted hash; absolute durations retained

lifetime: Exactly one live native bitmap, including oracle; retain only oracle dense answers before timed allocations
validation: All old/new inserted hashes present and every guarded mixed output equal through serial and unchanged-T public parallel queries after every timed instance
accounting: Original requested T, effective request, actual W, estimated public build scratch, spawned workers/caller model, actual bytes; no cross-language scheduling equivalence claim

placement.status: Exact socket/CPU list selected in later execution freeze; no compute lease now
placement.parallel: first T distinct physical cores of granted NUMA node; scheduler migration/colocation allowed
placement.insert_first_touch: constructor and history on primary CPU before expansion
placement.allocate_first_touch: allowed set expanded before constructor timer
placement.candidate_W1: Retains original T allowed-core budget; no separate precomputed dispatch

quality: No new FPR qualification or negative-sample pooling; semantic equivalence checks only
analysis: Same-language paired candidate/control and own shared serial reference; retain all per-seed/per-scenario losses; no production or global speed claim from this plan
preflight: Reuse existing48-case native normal/ASan proof; focused new harness/timing-boundary/CLI/guard checks only
